name: stability
description: How settled a strategy contract must be and when.

aiGuidance.purpose: Orders the v12 contracts by when they must stop moving relative to the F1-F3 boundaries.
aiGuidance.extraction: Pick the value the v12 source states; use deferred when no boundary needs the contract yet.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not a lifecycle state and not a priority; priority derives from objective rank.
